title: Cornered Knight
setup: Black's knight has landed on a5, where its four jumps are b3, c4, c6 and b7, and b7 is its own pawn.
hint: Your pawns on a2, d3 and d5 already watch three of the knight's four squares. Only the attack is missing.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{b4}} attacks the knight and it has nowhere: b3 runs into axb3, c4 into dxc4, c6 into dxc6, and b7 is blocked by Black's own pawn. A knight on a5 is one pawn move away from being an ex-knight.
